# iugu CLI

> Command-line tool for iugu Platform 2 Console: create, configure, test and publish apps; sensitive changes become human approvals.

- Skill: `iugu docs` (SKILL.md) — golden path, tiers, secrets policy, exit codes
- API contract: docs/public/api-v1.yaml in platform2-console (OpenAPI 3.1; every operation has x-iugu-scope, x-iugu-actions, x-iugu-tier)
- Remote MCP (for hosted/chat clients): https://mcp.console.iugu.com/mcp — configure with `iugu agent setup`
- Auth: `iugu login` (browser or device code; non-interactive handoff for agents) · `iugu auth status --json`
- Exit codes: 0 ok · 1 error · 2 usage · 4 login required · 5 approval required · 6 conflict
